headline: Certifying General Election results, plus discussion of ethics training and annual financial disclosure statements.
summary: The meeting includes certifying the results of the General Election. It also includes a discussion of ethics training and the annual Financial Disclosure Statement required by the Rhode Island Ethics Commission.
items: Certify the results of the General Election
Discussion of Ethics training and annual Financial Disclosure Statement for Board members required by the Rhode Island Ethics Commission
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
